_comment: Sidecar for ecosystem-scan target ranking. First matching rule wins; match is a case-insensitive substring test against the package name. Compiled from the 2026-09-05 bug bounty research pass (~/.thynkq/runs/perfect-edge-2026-09-05/income/bug-bounty-map.md). Nothing here is a claim about mcp-scan's own findings, only about whether a vendor pays for reports against that package.

rules.note: github.com/modelcontextprotocol is explicitly listed out of scope on Anthropic's HackerOne program.
Scope names MCP client trust boundary violations and supply chain attacks against published packages, a direct match for this scanner's checks.

GitHub's own server ships as a Go binary/Docker image at github.com/github/github-mcp-server, outside npm entirely. GitHub's bounty program would not cover this npm package.
